tools.name: penetration_check
tools.title: Penetration check
tools.summary: Deepest interpenetration of every geom pair over a state or trajectory, on all visible geometry, optionally relative to a reference trajectory.
tools.description: Loads an MJCF scene and recompiles it with every visible geom collidable, so that parts a scene normally draws but does not collide, such as arm links, are checked as well. For each frame it runs MuJoCo's collision detection and keeps, per geom pair, the deepest penetration seen. A pair fails when its depth exceeds the tolerance; with a reference trajectory it fails only when it exceeds the depth the same pair reaches in the reference plus the tolerance, so contacts the verified episode already had (a grasp, a seated object) are not counted as new collisions. Bodies joined by an equality constraint and bodies of one limb are never checked against each other, and MuJoCo itself never collides two bodies that are both fixed to the world. Any robot and any environment work; nothing is task specific.

inputs.name: scene
inputs.description: MJCF file of the scene. A compiled model also works, but then only geoms that already collide are checked, because mesh hulls are built at compile time.

inputs.name: qpos
inputs.description: The state or trajectory to check; the model's initial state when omitted.

inputs.name: baseline_qpos
inputs.description: Reference trajectory. Each pair may penetrate as deep as it does here, plus the tolerance.

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Penetration allowed beyond the reference, or in absolute terms without one. Default 0.003.

inputs.name: limbs
inputs.description: Groups of body names whose members are not checked against each other, for example one arm with its hand. Child bodies are included.

inputs.name: ignore
inputs.description: Regular expressions; a geom pair is skipped when either geom's 'body/geom' name matches one of them.

inputs.name: visual_groups
inputs.description: MuJoCo geom groups that count as visible. Default [0, 1, 2].

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: ok (bool); violations: the failing pairs, worst first, each with the two 'body/geom' names, depth, excess over the reference and the frame; worst: the single worst pair; n_pairs_touching; n_frames; n_geoms_made_collidable; tolerance.
